data.credibility: Management delivers on core margin and marketing targets, but frequently drops expansion metrics like outlet additions and capex without updates, showing mixed reliability in long-term strategic guidance.

lines.line: Operating margin hit 22% in FY26, beating the 19% to 21% promised range.
Marketing spend was kept at 4% for Q4 FY26, meeting the target.
Target to add 8,000 to 9,000 outlets was dropped by management without updates.
Planned capex of INR140 crores for FY26 was dropped without reporting actuals.
Expanded JKY Groove EBO reach to 500 by April 2026, successfully meeting target.
International GCC expansion plans were dropped and not mentioned in subsequent quarters.
Targeting INR40 crores to INR50 crores in FY27 subsidies, currently pending.
Aiming for double-digit volume growth in FY27, currently pending.
Network distributor DMS integration target by end of FY27 or Q1 FY28 is pending.
Consumer data platform go-live target for end of August remains pending.

bull: High capital efficiency is evident with an ROE of 54.3% and ROCE of 64.4% in the latest figures.
Strong cash conversion with operating cash flow at 107% of reported profit over the past five years.
EBITDA margin has steadily widened from 18.6% in FY21 to 22.0% in FY26.
bear: Revenue growth has slowed significantly to 3.6% annually over three years compared to 13.1% over five years.
Working-capital days have stretched from 10 days to 26 days over the past five years.
Borrowings increased to INR396 cr from INR127 cr in FY21 while operating cash flow was negative in FY23.
